item.title: The Kubernetes API
item.description: 1. Objects in Kubernetes Kubernetes objects are persistent entities in the system, used to represent the state of the cluster. Users interact with Kubernetes by operating on objects, telling the system the workload they expect. Objects are manipulated through the Kubernetes API. Every Kubernetes object contains two nested object fields, Spec and Status.
